title: Tusk project settings
description: Project settings for the Tusk editor that a team shares by committing this file. Tusk keeps keys it doesn't know as they are.

$schema.description: The JSON schema for this file.

indexExclude.description: Folders the PHP index and Mago skip, relative to the project. `*` matches within a folder name, and `**` any number of folders.

debugPathMappings.description: Where the project is on the server, for code that runs in Docker or on another machine: comma-separated entries, each `/server/path` (the project folder) or `/server/path=local/path`. A local path without a leading / is inside the project. Empty when PHP runs on this Mac.

debugExceptions.description: When the debugger pauses on exceptions.

pause.description: Whether to pause on exceptions at all.

classes.description: Exception classes to pause on, with their subclasses. Empty pauses on every exception and error.

uncaughtOnly.description: Pause only on exceptions that nothing catches.

skip.description: Path patterns, relative to the project, where a thrown exception doesn't pause, such as vendor/**.

debugWatches.description: Watch expressions the debugger evaluates each time it pauses.

breakpoints.description: Line breakpoints by file, relative to the project: pairs of a line number and the breakpoint's options.

condition.description: A PHP expression; the breakpoint pauses only when it's true.

hitCondition.description: Pause on a hit count, such as `>= 3` or `% 2`.

logMessage.description: Log this message instead of pausing. `{$expression}` inserts a value.

dockerService.description: The Docker Compose service that runs tests, Artisan, and Tinker. Empty runs them on the host.

deploymentServers.description: Servers the project deploys to over SFTP, FTP, or FTPS. Passwords and key passphrases never go here: each person's stay in their Keychain.

name.description: The server's name, such as staging.

protocol.description: How Tusk connects: SFTP over SSH, plain FTP, or FTPS with explicit (AUTH TLS) or implicit TLS.

host.description: The server's host name or address.

port.description: The port. Defaults to 22 for SFTP, 21 for FTP and explicit FTPS, and 990 for implicit FTPS.

user.description: The user to log in as. Empty is your own user for SFTP, and anonymous for FTP.

auth.description: SFTP's login: the SSH agent, a key file, or a password.

keyFile.description: The private key for SFTP's key login. Empty tries ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_ecdsa, and id_rsa.

passive.description: FTP's passive mode. Defaults to true.

insecureTls.description: FTPS without checking the server's certificate, for a self-signed one.

rootPath.description: The folder mappings are relative to, such as /var/www/app. Empty is the login folder.

webUrl.description: The site's address, for opening deployed files in the browser.

mappings.description: Where project folders go on the server.

local.description: A folder relative to the project. Empty is the whole project.

remote.description: Where it goes: relative to the root path, or absolute.

excludes.description: Paths never uploaded or downloaded. A name matches at any depth; a path with / matches from the mapping's folder.

deleteRemote.description: Delete a project file from the server when you delete it, while saved files upload to this server.

databaseConnections.description: Saved database connections. URLs never hold passwords here: each person's password stays in their Keychain.

url.description: The connection URL without a password, such as mysql://user@host:3306/database, pgsql://…, sqlite:database/other.sqlite, or redis://host:6379/0.

runConfigurations.description: Run configurations shared with the team. Each has a name, a type, and that type's fields; configurations you don't share stay on your Mac.

name.description: The configuration's name, unique in the project.

type.description: What it runs: PHPUnit or Pest tests, an Artisan command, a PHP script, a Composer script, an npm script, a shell command, or a PHP web server.

cwd.description: The folder to run in, relative to the project. Empty for the project folder.

docker.description: Run in the project's container (Sail, or the chosen Compose service) when it's up. Tests, Artisan commands, and PHP scripts do by default.

before.description: Steps to run first, in order. A step that fails stops the launch.

multiple.description: Allow running it again while it runs, instead of stopping it first.

runner.description: Tests: the test runner. auto tries php artisan test, then Pest, then PHPUnit.

path.description: Tests: the directory or file. PHP script: the script. Server: the document root.

filter.description: Tests: the class, the method or Pest description, or a --filter pattern.

configFile.description: Tests: the PHPUnit configuration file, such as phpunit.xml.

command.description: The Artisan command, the Composer or npm script, or the shell command line.

args.description: More arguments, as you'd type them in a shell.

server.description: Server: php artisan serve, or PHP's built-in server.

host.description: Server: the host to listen on.

formatters.description: The formatter and format on save for each language group: php, blade, js (JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue), css, json, markdown, and yaml.

use.description: The formatter: auto, a specific one, builtin (Monaco's own), or none.

onSave.description: Whether saving formats the file. Without it, the Format files when saving setting decides.

phpInterpreter.description: The PHP program this project uses instead of the one in Settings > Tools, such as /opt/homebrew/opt/php@8.3/bin/php.

phpAnalysis.description: Tusk's PHP index for this project. Mago's own settings live in mago.toml.

loadAllLibraries.description: Read every file in vendor in full, not only the code the project reaches. Uses several times the memory.

stubs.description: Comma-separated folders or PHP files, relative to the project, that the index reads as library code, such as stubs for a PHP extension.

phpstan.description: How Tusk runs PHPStan in this project. Settings > PHPStan sets these; a missing key uses its default.

enabled.description: `auto` runs PHPStan when the project has vendor/bin/phpstan; `on` also says so when it doesn't; `off` never runs it.

config.description: The configuration file, relative to the project. Empty lets PHPStan find phpstan.neon, phpstan.neon.dist, or phpstan.dist.neon.

level.description: The rule level, `0` to `10` or `max`, over the configuration file's. Empty uses the file's.

memoryLimit.description: PHP's memory limit for PHPStan, such as `2G`, or `-1` for none.

timeout.description: Seconds a run may take before it's stopped.

run.description: `save` checks files as they open and each time they're saved; `demand` only when you run PHPStan on the project.

databaseSsh.description: The SSH tunnel each database connection goes through, by connection name. The empty name is .env's connection.

oneOf.description: An SSH destination, such as forge@203.0.113.5, ssh://user@host:2222, or a host from ~/.ssh/config.

destination.description: An SSH destination, such as forge@203.0.113.5.

identityFile.description: The private key to use, such as ~/.ssh/staging. Without it, ssh uses your agent and ~/.ssh/config.

databaseReadOnly.description: Database connections that refuse changes, by connection name. The empty name is .env's connection.
